name: pi-telegram-bridge-host
description: A durable, systemd-supervised Pi host for the pi-telegram extension

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "await import('./dist/src/memory-application.js')"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:extensions && npm run typecheck:telegram && npm test
scripts.check:changed: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:extensions && npm run typecheck:telegram && npm run test:changed
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/patch-codex-conversion.mjs && node scripts/patch-telegram-tool-activity.mjs && node scripts/patch-telegram-new-session-dedup.mjs && node scripts/patch-telegram-agent-settled.mjs && node scripts/patch-telegram-subagent-target-scope.mjs && node scripts/patch-telegram-model-menu-return.mjs && node scripts/patch-telegram-new-session-menu.mjs && node scripts/patch-telegram-debug.mjs
scripts.test:pi-compat: vitest run tests/pi-compatibility.test.ts tests/codex-extension.test.ts tests/codex-request.test.ts tests/host.integration.test.ts tests/retry-extension.test.ts tests/telegram-new-session.test.ts tests/subagent-process.test.ts tests/conversation-session-policy.test.ts tests/conversation-routing.test.ts
